vce.text: option vce() must be robust or windmeijer

coef_ci_type.text: option coefcitype() must be symmetric or percentile

coef_boot_gs.text: coefboot(gs) is not implemented: the available scheme is a threshold-search-aware cluster wild residual bootstrap, not the Gong-Seo coefficient bootstrap. Use coefboot(twostep|onestep|none).

coef_boot.text: option coefboot() must be twostep, onestep, or none

grid_type.text: option gridtype() must be uniform or quantile

refine_high.text: option refine() must be an integer between 0 and 20

refine_negative.text: option refine() must be an integer between 0 and 20

refine_kink.text: refine() is supported for the jump specification only (the kink regressor (q-gamma)*1(q>gamma) varies continuously in gamma)

search_mode.text: searchmode(), searchmax(), and searchtol() are no longer supported in xtdpthres The threshold search is a fixed finite grid selected by grid(#), with optional

search_max.text: searchmode(), searchmax(), and searchtol() are no longer supported in xtdpthres The threshold search is a fixed finite grid selected by grid(#), with optional

search_tol.text: searchmode(), searchmax(), and searchtol() are no longer supported in xtdpthres The threshold search is a fixed finite grid selected by grid(#), with optional

history.text: option history() must be panel or sample

history_sample_lag.text: history(sample) cannot retro-restrict time-series-operator terms (L.x, D.x, ...): they are materialized on the full panel before if/in applies. Pre-generate the lagged variables as plain variables, or use history(panel).

boot_type_exact.text: boottype(exact) has been renamed boottype(unit): the unit-resampling scheme is Alg. 1-oriented but not certified as the exact algorithm

boot_type.text: option boottype() must be wild or unit

unit_fod.text: boottype(unit) currently supports method(fd) only (Gong-Seo Alg. 1 is developed for the first-differenced estimator)

unit_kink.text: boottype(unit) does not support kink (Alg. 1 targets the unrestricted jump estimator)

grid_sample.text: option gridsample() must be effective or observed

lev_maxlag.text: levmaxlag() was retired with method(system); use maxlag() for FD/FOD moments

iv_maxlag.text: iv() sub-option maxlag() is not supported (v0.7.0): user-supplied IVs always enter as their period-t value, so maxlag() never affected them — it only (silently) overrode the top-level maxlag() controlling GMM-style instruments. Use the top-level maxlag() option instead.

method_system.text: method(system) is no longer supported as of xtdpthresh 0.9.25 The supported estimators are method(fd) and method(fod).

method.text: option method() must be fd or fod

gamma_test_noboot.text: citest() requires the grid bootstrap (remove noboot)

continuity_noboot.text: conttest requires the bootstrap tests (remove noboot and notest)

continuity_notest.text: conttest requires the bootstrap tests (remove noboot and notest)

n_boot_small.text: boot should be at least 10 (99+ recommended for production)

seed_fraction.text: rseed() must be an integer in [0, 2147483647]

seed_negative.text: rseed() must be an integer in [0, 2147483647]

seed_large.text: rseed() must be an integer in [0, 2147483647]

level_low.text: level() must be between 10 and 99.99 inclusive

level_high.text: level() must be between 10 and 99.99 inclusive

maxlag_zero.text: maxlag() invalid -- invalid numlist has elements outside of allowed range

maxlag_three.text: maxlag() invalid -- invalid numlist has too many elements

maxlag_fraction.text: maxlag() invalid -- invalid numlist has noninteger elements

td_unit.text: boottype(unit) is not available with td: unit resampling changes the time-effects FWL projection in every draw, which is not replayed. Use boottype(wild), or remove td.

td_twostep.text: coefboot(twostep) is not available with td: the two-step replay requires recomputing the time-effects FWL projection in every draw. Use coefboot(onestep) or coefboot(none).
